name: Neon Dragulescu Buzau
original_name: 音遠＝ドラグレスク＝ブザウ
source:
Half Romanian, half Japanese, she comes to Yuunagi City for specific objective.

After meeting Suzuka, she becomes obsessed about her. She has a hobby of collecting human bones.
